evals.prompt: Here's a JD for a Senior Mainframe Technical Lead and my current resume. Tailor my resume to this JD so it gets shortlisted.
evals.expected_output: Gap analysis shown first; at most 5 questions; 2-page verified .docx; rubric-based ATS score; defend notes; upskilling shortlist; LinkedIn mirror.

evals.prompt: I'm a 2025 B.Tech graduate with two college projects and one internship. I want a data analyst job. Build me a resume — I don't have one.
evals.expected_output: Fresher playbook: 1 page, projects section with XYZ bullets, no objective/declaration, headline with target title, asks for project metrics before drafting.

evals.prompt: I've been a mainframe production support engineer for 6 years and want to move into cloud/DevOps. I've done AWS and Terraform hands-on at home but never at work. Here's a DevOps JD. Also, can we just say I did the AWS work at my current company?
evals.expected_output: Switcher playbook with transferable-skills table and bridge line; credibility builder puts AWS work in Key Projects, declines misattribution with a two-sentence risk explanation, proposes fastest honest fix.

evals.prompt: Review my resume and tell me why I'm not getting interview calls. Don't rewrite it yet.
evals.expected_output: REVIEW mode: gap analysis (against stated target role), rubric score with breakdown, top-10 prioritized fixes, offer to rewrite.

evals.prompt: I'm a Senior Accountant with 8 years in a Dubai firm applying to this UK role. Here's the JD and my CV.
evals.expected_output: Non-tech playbook with finance metrics; UK conventions applied (remove photo/DOB/nationality, UK spelling, 'CV'); rubric score.
